papers.title: IIR-BinNet: An Ultra-Lightweight Neural Network for Document Image Binarization Using IIR Filters
papers.abstract: We present IIR-BinNet, a document image binarization network built from infinite impulse response filters. The model uses 49K parameters, at least 40 times smaller than a U-Net baseline, and reaches an F-measure of 90.37% on H-DIBCO 2018 against 89.36% for that baseline. Evaluation covers DIBCO 2017 and H-DIBCO 2018 page images.
